metadata.description: Delegation control plane for Claude Code: implementation goes to a GPT-6 Luna/Sol Codex lane by default (Luna Max for narrow retries) and escalates to Claude Opus 5.5 for a named reason, each lane isolated in its own git worktree, routed by a deterministic policy with optional Jev adaptive routing (shadow, log-only, by default), with Opus 5.5 senior review and Fable 5 reserved for reframing stuck problems and exceptional review.

plugins.name: fable-advisor
plugins.description: Implementation goes to the Codex lane by default (GPT-6 Luna at high; Luna at max for a narrow retry; Sol for broad integration-heavy work) and escalates to Claude Opus 5.5 at high only for one of five named reasons. Obvious routes are decided by rule; optional Jev routing (FABLE_JEV_MODE=off|shadow|active) handles only the ambiguous middle behind a confidence and eligibility gate. Every lane runs in a disposable worktree. Lanes: Codex, a haiku/sonnet/opus implementer, a read-only Opus 5.5 reviewer, and a read-only Fable 5 advisor for reframes and exceptional review.
